notes: «حدثنا أبي» names the father only by relation, so it is a relation link. «وغيره» is an unnamed co-transmitter at the same level. The Imam after «عن» stays a narrator.

needs_ruling: after «قال سمعته يقول» the first-person speaker («فقلت») is not named, so it is not settled whether the last link is Ibn Sinan's hearing or the Imam's own words. The gloss «ع» is left out.
